title: Japan PM gets muted welcome in China, unlike other Apec leaders

blocks.text: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on Wednesday received a lower-key welcome than some other leaders when she arrived in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum summit. Images of the arrivals of several leaders showed young people holding red bouquets and raising their arms in enthusiastic welcome ceremonies. No similar reception was evident for Takaichi, highlighting lingering tensions between China and Japan. By contrast, U.S. President Donald Trump was personally greeted by Chinese President Xi Jinping upon arrival, while Russian President Vladimir Putin was welcomed by Cai Qi, China’s fifth-ranked leader.
